name: native-demo
description: Vue + Zig + Native SDK WebView desktop application template

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:config:check && zig build dev
scripts.check: pnpm run version:check && pnpm run dev:config:check && pnpm run windows:loader:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run scripts:test && pnpm run frontend:check && pnpm run native:doctor && pnpm run test
scripts.package: pnpm run windows:loader:check && zig build package portable
scripts.package:standard: pnpm run windows:loader:check && zig build package
scripts.portable: pnpm run windows:loader:check && zig build portable
scripts.frontend:dev: pnpm run dev:config:check && pnpm --dir src_web run dev
scripts.format: oxfmt . && zig fmt build.zig build.zig.zon src
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check . && zig fmt --check build.zig build.zig.zon src
